# Bite And Diet — www.biteanddiet.in

> Bite And Diet provides personalized diet plans and expert nutrition consulting by Dietician Priyanka — a trustworthy dietician in Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Haryana) with over 10 years of experience. Services cover weight loss, weight gain, diabetes management, PCOS, thyroid, fatty liver, kidney health, and more, through online and personal consultations.

For the most complete and accurate information, use the extended file [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).
